description: Change a task's words, due date or who owes it. Give only what changes. Use it to fix a task, not to close one: complete_task for done, dismiss_task for a duplicate or a wrong task.

dueDate.description: Optional: the new due date, YYYY-MM-DD

owner.description: Optional: who owes it: "me" for the user, or a person's name for a promise they made the user

taskId.description: The ID of the task to change

name: update_task
